properties.anpr:
SELECT id AS "eventId", plate, cameraId, locationId,
       TRUE AS "watchlisted",
       "timestamp" AS "eventTimeMillis"
FROM FLOWFILE
properties.single_match:
SELECT 'SINGLE_MATCH' AS "type",
       id AS "eventId", plate, cameraId, locationId, reason,
       "timestamp" AS "eventTimeMillis"
FROM FLOWFILE

       FALSE AS "watchlisted",
       "timestamp" AS "eventTimeMillis"
FROM FLOWFILE
